metadata.description: Deploys Volt Typhoon detection pack scheduled analytics rules into a Microsoft Sentinel workspace.
Name of the Log Analytics workspace that has Microsoft Sentinel enabled.
Whether the deployed analytics rules are enabled on creation.

properties.displayName: Volt Typhoon - PortProxy Registry Rule Creation
properties.description: PortProxy v*tov* registry value created - the obfuscation-proof netsh C2 relay artifact.
properties.query:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where RegistryKey has @"\Services\PortProxy\"
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\v4tov4", @"\v4tov6", @"\v6tov4", @"\v6tov6")
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

properties.displayName: Volt Typhoon - NTDS.dit Theft via ntdsutil IFM
properties.description: ntdsutil Install-From-Media full copy - signature Volt Typhoon AD database theft.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe") or (ProcessCommandLine has "ntdsutil")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance ntds")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

properties.displayName: Volt Typhoon - LSASS Dump via comsvcs MiniDump
properties.description: rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump against LSASS, including the #24 ordinal evasion.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_cs "MiniDump" or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("#24","#+24","# 24")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

properties.displayName: Volt Typhoon - Security Event Log Cleared
properties.description: Security log cleared (Event 1102) - anti-forensics after credential theft / lateral movement.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 1102
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Activity, Account
